digest.component_or_area: Codebase quality audit remediation (CI reliability, user docs, module complexity/typing)
propositions: CI test suite has reliability flak in Python 3.11 xdist worker execution of test_opcert_service_app that must be root-caused and durably fixed
User-facing documentation contains an assignee example that is inconsistent with docs/config.md and Jira identity resolution semantics

Three near-cap modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py) exceed or approach the 800 LOC threshold and mix responsibilities across layers, requiring decomposition by responsibility/layer along call-graph seams while preserving public import paths
Graph subsystem contains duplicated loader and traversal infrastructure across _blockers and _compute_dep_graph functions that drives high cyclomatic complexity and must be centralized
attest package has untyped function definitions that prevent mypy type-checking under --disallow-untyped-defs
Module complexity and file-size ratchet baselines in .github/complexity-baseline.json must be regenerated after decomposition splits to reflect new lower CCN targets
